gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-hanuman: Capture It stands on a towering x-height, with letters nearly sealed shut. Hanuman, a serif with high-waisted lowercase, lets text unfold gradually, its wide-set s terminals loosening up everything the heading keeps shut.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-kadwa: Urban through and through, Capture It keeps its letters nearly sealed. Kadwa, a classic serif with open-ended curves, loosens things below, so the heading's sturdy diagonals sit above a much lighter-handed text.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-marcellus-sc: Marcellus SC reads dignified and literary, with gentle modulation in each stroke. Capture It traces a single thick thread with towering force, while the classic serif body spends its calm weight variation from stem to serif on refinement.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-montagu-slab: Sealed-up heading letters, then a body that swings the door open. Capture It draws a plotter-pen line, while Montagu Slab, a serif with a sizable x-height, thins its g's links and keeps sturdy bowls.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-piazzolla: Plain, unshaded and blunt, Capture It never swells a line anywhere. Capture It does its best work as towering, sealed display type, while Piazzolla excels at refined lowercase that nearly matches its capitals.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-marcellus-s: Raw and tactical up top, with big-bodied lowercase letters throughout. Marcellus SC, with its classic serif build and pulled-back terminals, feels dignified and literary beside it, a quieter, more bookish voice.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-noto-serif-: Raw and tactical, Capture Smallz leans on big-bodied lowercase letters for its punch. And Noto Serif Hentaigana, a serif with open jaws on its curves, adds subtle modulation and small letters nearly as tall as capitals.
gen-dafont-college-gf-domine: Domine reads refined and dignified, with a breathing space inside every curved glyph. And College, with its plain ballpoint-weight lines, hands over to paragraphs that glide on a measured swell from hairline to stem.
gen-dafont-college-gf-esteban: College brings big counters and curves that match its straight stems, while Esteban sets a moderate stroke contrast. Standout: the classic serif body's oversized lowercase, sitting beside its own capitals.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-ovo: Ovo reads classic and authoritative, with a tall middle band, shallow ascenders and descenders, and the gentle shift of soft pencil. Under Conthrax and its pipe-cleaner joins, paragraphs would settle in easily.
